answer.outline: A risk register records the finding, impact, mitigation, verification method, owner and rollback for each high-priority gap.
suggested_steps: Never expose the interactive debugger in production.
Use trusted host and proxy configuration based on real infrastructure.
Keep evidence links and make no claim of production verification without actual tests.
